description: This file defines the 'Company' class, which extends the 'Basic' class, representing a company entity within the SuiteCRM application. It contains properties and methods related to handling company data, including email address management, saving logic, and export query creation.

classes.name: Company
classes.description: A class representing a company within the SuiteCRM system, providing methods for managing company data, email addresses, and export functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the emailAddress property and calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the company data, handles email address saving, and generates a new GUID if necessary.

methods.name: fill_in_relationship_fields
methods.description: Populates email address fields to ensure they are available for logic hooks.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares the data array for list views, including generating email links.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Generates an SQL query for exporting company data, including email addresses and user data.
